name: Belial
source:
The golden-skinned and prideful demoness of the Seven Deadly Sins, Belial knows herself to be the most beautiful, the smartest, and the most worthy entity in the cosmos. She doesn't think she's better—she knows everyone else is beneath her.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
